mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.project_id, t.task_no, t.milestone_id, t.parent_id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.assignee_id, a.username AS assignee_username, a.real_name AS assignee_real_name, t.creator_id, c.username AS creator_username, c.real_name AS creator_real_name, t.importance, t.urgency, t.plan_days, t.est_hours, t.required_skills, t.progress, t.plan_start, t.due_date, t.actual_start, t.actual_end, t.sort_order, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM task t LEFT JOIN sys_user a ON a.id = t.assignee_id JOIN sys_user c ON c.id = t.creator_id
mapper.select: WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.id
WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.status = #{status} ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.id
SELECT id FROM project WHERE id = #{projectId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(task_no), 0) FROM task WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (project_id, task_no, milestone_id, parent_id, title, description, status, assignee_id, creator_id, importance, urgency, plan_days, est_hours, required_skills, progress, plan_start, due_date, actual_start, actual_end, sort_order) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{taskNo}, #{milestoneId}, #{parentId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{assigneeId}, #{creatorId}, #{importance}, #{urgency}, #{planDays}, #{estHours}, #{requiredSkills,typeHandler=org.miniteam.pms.common.mybatis.JsonStringListTypeHandler}, #{progress}, #{planStart}, #{dueDate}, #{actualStart}, #{actualEnd}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT assignee_id AS user_id, COALESCE(SUM(est_hours), 0) AS load_hours, COUNT(*) AS task_count FROM task WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'DONE' GROUP BY assignee_id
